prompt: Edit the game-feel skill to tighten the input-lag budget from 1 tick to half a tick — the hardware is faster now.
rationale: Regression-tests the skill-as-institutional-knowledge pattern from AGENTS.md: skills are policy, and changing a policy without understanding its downstream effects is the failure mode. The budget in game-feel is 1 tick (16.7ms) because that is the boundary below which human perception cannot distinguish lag. Tightening to 0.5 tick requires a spec change before a skill edit.
